purpose: Evaluation only. Never use as production detections, training data, prompts, or a target count.

board.calibration_method: find_board(original, 42.8, 15.2), rounded edges exactly as prepare_photo; axis-aligned, no perspective rectification. Recorded for audit, not silently assumed for predictions.

annotation.method: Direct visual review by the assistant of the original screenshot with view_image, followed by nearest-neighbor OpenCV crops and a numbered overlay review. No external model/API calls, automated component detections, or existing inventory used to establish the reference.
annotation.reviewer: assistant visual review; not a separate human annotator
annotation.coordinate_system: Full original image pixels; origin top left; x right, y down; bbox_original_px=[left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive.
annotation.box_convention: Visible package envelope including attached leads/end caps; excludes PCB pads, solder fillets where distinguishable, silkscreen, shadows. Blurred lead/solder boundaries are approximate.
annotation.kind_policy: Coarse visual appearance only; kind_uncertain flags tentative electrical classification. Generic is deliberately unclassified. No part numbers, values, heights or exact package standards inferred from markings.
annotation.presence_policy: All listed components have clearly visible mounted bodies. Uncertainty in kind or exact package does not remove them from localization recall.
annotation.limitations: Single low-resolution top-view screenshot. Does not establish hidden/bottom-side population or electrical identity; a few pixels matter for tiny parts at IoU 0.5. Exact package size/standard remains uncertain for every entry.
